rec.name: PDP Collapsible Description with Default-Open Option

what.text: A Description block for the PDP buy box that can be shown in two layouts: 'Collapsible' (an accordion-style header with an arrow icon, which expands and collapses the product description) or 'Normal' (plain description text). In Collapsible layout, a checkbox lets you choose whether the description is open on page load. This gives two test variants: (1) nothing expanded initially, (2) the 'Description' tab expanded initially. The ticket asked for a universal section that works in any Shopify theme. What was built is a Description block only, not a generic multi-tab component.

why.text: Open by default: product information is visible immediately, so there is less friction for shoppers who want details before buying. This helps users who don't notice or don't click collapsed accordions, and keeps key value messaging in view near the add-to-cart button. Collapsed by default: a shorter page keeps the buy box compact, so the CTA, reviews and cross-sell blocks below stay close to the fold, and users can open only what they need. Which one wins depends on the product and audience, which is why it is worth testing.

how.text: Three code steps in a Shopify theme. (1) In main-product.liquid, replace the 'description' block schema with an extended one. It adds settings for top/bottom spacing, layout (Collapsible/Normal), 'Open button as default', border, header text, font size, padding and colors. (2) Create the snippet ed-collapsible-description.liquid. It outputs scoped CSS, a toggle button with a circular arrow icon (aria-expanded), and a collapsible content container holding product.description. A small JS handler animates height over 500ms and rotates the arrow. When layout is 'normal', it renders the plain description. (3) In product-form.liquid, replace the `when 'description'` case with `{% render 'ed-collapsible-description', section: section, block: block, product: product %}`. In the theme editor, select the Description block, set Layout = Collapsible, and toggle 'Open button as default' on or off to create the A/B variants.

items: Open button as default (checkbox, default off)

dependencies.text: No metafields or apps. It uses the native product.description and the theme's main-product.liquid and product-form.liquid files, whose structure must match (a 'description' block type and `when 'description'` case). The theme should support the `rte` and `product-form__description` classes. Implementation caveats (inferred from the code): the aria-controls/ID is hardcoded as 'block-id-2', so multiple instances on one page would conflict. The schema snippet has a trailing comma after the last setting, which must be removed or the JSON schema will be invalid. The JS query is global (.ed-collapsible-toggle) and shows no guard against double-binding on section reload. Only the Description tab is covered, not other product tabs.

items: Click rate on the Description toggle (variant 1)
Engagement with blocks below the buy box (reviews, UGC, cross-sell)

images.caption: Theme editor showing the Description block configured as Collapsible with 'Open button as default' on. The header 'Description' has a circular arrow icon and a bottom border, and the description text is expanded below the add-to-cart button. The settings panel on the right lists all configurable options.
Live preview of the PDP buy box: size selector, 'ZUM WARENKORB HINZUFÜGEN' CTA, then the expanded Description accordion with the UGC section below it.
